phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Establish exercise habits and basic nutrition

phases.name: Progression
phases.focus: Increase intensity and refine nutrition for fat loss

phases.name: Optimization
phases.focus: Maximize fat loss and glycaemic control

non_negotiables: Monitor blood glucose before, during, and after exercise
Have fast-acting carbohydrate available during sessions
No fasting or extreme low-carb diets
Prioritize balanced meals with consistent carbohydrate intake
Consult with physician before starting programme

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control for Type 2 Diabetes"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary fat_loss:
    name "Fat Loss"
  GOAL secondary glycaemic_control:
    name "Glycaemic Control"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full-body strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 3m
      DAY Tuesday training 40m "Cardio/intervals":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x20 rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 3m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper body strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 3m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Lower body strength":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 3m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 3m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Active recovery/mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          child_pose 2x1 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x1 rpe 1 rest 30 seconds

          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
